english.title: Registered person fail to send report as to governance of services to Care Quality Commission
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[service provider]_
(B)_[registered manager]_

in respect of a regulated activity, namely **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITY..), failed to send to the Commission, when requested to do so and by no later than 28 days beginning on the day after receipt of the request, a written report setting out how, and the extent to which, in your opinion, the requirements of regulation 17(2)(a) and (b) of the Health and Social Care Act 2008 (Regulated Activities) Regulations 2014 in respect of governance were being complied with and any plans that you had for improving the standard of the services provided to service users with a view to ensuring their health and welfare
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 17(3), 22(1)(c) and 23(5) of the Health and Social Care Act 2008 (Regulated Activities) Regulations 2014.

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 8(1) and (2) provides that a registered person must comply with regulations 9 to 20A in carrying on a regulated activity, unless the thing to be done has by another registered person in relation to the regulated activity concerned.
(ii) As per regulation 22(4), it is a defence for a registered person to prove that they took all reasonable steps and exercised all due diligence to prevent the breach.
